title: FinTrack bank sync
description: Bank connections, each sync, TrueLayer and the scheduled jobs that drive them.

list.name: Releases
list.expr: group by (service_version) (target_info{job="$service"}) unless group by (service_version) (target_info{job="$service"} offset 10m)

panels.title: Syncs succeeded
panels.description: Connections synced without failing over the time range.

panels.title: Syncs failed
panels.description: Connections whose sync failed over the time range.

panels.title: Fetches failed
panels.description: Fetches from the bank that failed over the time range. The rest of each sync carried on without that data.

panels.title: Transactions added
panels.description: Transactions seen for the first time over the time range.

panels.title: Transactions updated
panels.description: Transactions already known that a sync changed, such as pending ones settling.

panels.title: Oldest sync
panels.description: How long ago the connection that's waited longest last synced. Syncs run every 4 hours.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Bank connections in each state over time. Renewal due means the bank's consent ends soon, lapsed that it has, failing that syncs keep failing.

panels.title: Oldest sync
panels.description: Climbs while nothing syncs and drops when the longest-waiting connection does.

panels.title: Sync time
panels.description: How long one connection takes to sync, from starting to saving or failing.

panels.title: Syncs
panels.description: Connections synced by outcome, and fetches from the bank that failed within them.

panels.title: Transactions brought in
panels.description: Transactions syncs added for the first time or updated.

panels.title: Steps of a sync
panels.description: FinTrack's own steps over the time range, from its traces: the jobs, each connection's sync and the work after it. Slowest first.

panels.title: Changed by rules
panels.description: Transactions your rules categorised, hid or marked over the time range.

panels.title: New transfers
panels.description: Transactions newly decided to be transfers between accounts over the time range.

panels.title: Transfers to review
panels.description: Transactions that might be transfers, put up for someone to check, over the time range.

panels.title: Bill payments matched
panels.description: Transactions whose bill changed over the time range, newly paying one or no longer.

panels.title: Subscriptions suggested
panels.description: New subscriptions suggested from repeating payments over the time range.

panels.title: Balances snapshotted
panels.description: Account balances recorded for the day over the time range, the history behind the net worth chart.

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: What transfer matching decided: transfer, to review, or an earlier decision cleared.

panels.title: Bills
panels.description: Bills added from new standing orders and direct debits, ended, or following a price change, and subscriptions suggested.

panels.title: Rules and bill payments
panels.description: Transactions rules changed, and transactions whose bill changed.

panels.title: Calls to TrueLayer
panels.description: Calls FinTrack made to TrueLayer a second, by the kind of answer. 429 is TrueLayer asking it to slow down.

panels.title: TrueLayer response time
panels.description: How long TrueLayer took to answer, by its API.

panels.title: Waiting for the rate limit
panels.description: How long calls queued for FinTrack's own limit on TrueLayer calls, and how many calls to anything were retried.

panels.title: Job runs
panels.description: Each scheduled job's runs over the time range, by result, and how long they took.

panels.title: Job run time
panels.description: How long each job took, p95. Jobs run on a schedule, so the lines are gaps between dots.

panels.title: Sync logs
panels.description: What each sync did, and the problems it hit, newest first.

targets.expr: {service_name="$service"} |~ "(?i)synced connection|truelayer refused|no active consent|started failing|syncs again|error occured syncing|re-authentication"
